mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(grand_total) AS total_sales, SUM(discount_total) AS total_discounts, SUM(tax_total) AS total_tax, SUM(grand_total - discount_total + tax_total) AS total_net_sales, (SELECT SUM(grand_total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'REFUNDED' AND created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) AS total_refunds FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND status = 'PAID'

SELECT p.name AS paymentType, SUM(op.amount) AS totalAmount FROM order_payments op JOIN payments p ON op.payment_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.name

SELECT od.product_id, od.product_name, SUM(od.amount) AS total_sales, SUM(od.quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND od.created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY od.product_id, od.product_name ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) AS report_date, od.product_id, od.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(sku_qty.quantity_sold), 0) AS quantity, SUM(od.amount) AS net_sales, SUM(od.amount / NULLIF(o.sub_total, 0) * o.discount_total) AS discount FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_detail_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM order_detail_skus GROUP BY order_detail_id ) sku_qty ON sku_qty.order_detail_id = od.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at), od.product_id, od.product_name ORDER BY report_date, quantity DESC

SELECT od.category_id AS categoryId, od.category_name AS categoryName, od.product_id AS productId, od.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sku_qty.quantity_sold), 0) AS quantity, SUM(od.amount) AS grossSales, SUM(od.amount / NULLIF(o.sub_total, 0) * o.discount_total) AS discount, SUM(od.amount) - SUM(od.amount / NULLIF(o.sub_total, 0) * o.discount_total) AS netSales FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_detail_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM order_detail_skus GROUP BY order_detail_id ) sku_qty ON sku_qty.order_detail_id = od.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY od.category_id, od.category_name, od.product_id, od.product_name ORDER BY od.category_name, quantity DESC

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS report_date, HOUR(created_at) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at), HOUR(created_at) ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM hourly WHERE order_count = ( SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM hourly h WHERE h.report_date = hourly.report_date ) ), 0) AS peakTimeOrders
